events.title: We are seeing a 'K-shaped economy' in housing, says Zelman’s Alan Ratner
events.description: Alan Ratner, managing director at Zelman, joins ‘Squawk on the Street’ to discuss the impact of higher mortgage rates on homebuilders, whether housing is also seeing a 'K-shaped economy,' and more.

events.title: 42% of homeowners say insurance costs have gone up 'a lot,' survey finds. Here's why
events.description: Inflation, climate change and other factors have combined to push up premiums for homeowners insurance — with broad implications for consumers and the economy.

events.title: Mortgage refinance demand drops 18% as rates hit highest level since August
events.description: Mortgage rates rose to the highest level in nine months, hitting refinance demand hardest. Homebuyers also pulled back but were still more active than last year.
